reading.body:
Flexential Las Vegas - North publishes 9 MW of IT capacity across 111,000 square feet, enough to support roughly 225 GPU-dense racks or 900 traditional colocation racks depending on actual customer workload density.

The certification stack qualifies this campus for heavily regulated AI workloads. SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II cover financial and operational controls. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data. ITAR qualifies it for export-controlled defense technical data. NIST 800-53 aligns it with federal security controls. HITRUST qualifies it for healthcare information. These certifications open the facility to finance, defense, and healthcare tenants, though which ones occupy it is unpublished.

Within Nevada, this campus ranks first by published IT capacity. This ranking reflects a data gap rather than dominance. Only one of 26 mapped facilities in the state has published a power figure on its operator spec page. The remaining 25 publish no megawatt capacity, so the 9 MW total for Nevada here represents only what operators have chosen to disclose, not the true installed base.
